name: Leviafan: Poslednij den' Dekady
source: The game takes place in the world of Leviathan, where a cyberpunk meets dark fantasy kind of world. The player gets to know this brutal dystopian world where the nobility revels in luxury, pleasures and perversions, while the common folk suffers and dies from a terrible plague. The main character, a noble-born boy, gets adopted by the one who has killed his parents. The law is powerless as the murderer comes from one of the most influential families, that has taken over all the city...
translation: 游戏发生在利维坦的世界，赛博朋克与黑暗奇幻的世界相遇。玩家将了解这个残酷的反乌托邦世界，贵族沉迷于奢华、享乐和变态，而普通百姓则遭受可怕的瘟疫的折磨和死亡。主角是一位出身贵族的男孩，被杀害父母的人收养。法律无能为力，因为凶手来自最有影响力的家族之一，这个家族已经占领了整个城市……
